title: CapabilityEntry
description: Schema for a single capability entry in .governance/capabilities/registry.yaml

agent_surfaces.description: Derived agent discoverability flags — computed by inventory_capabilities.py, not stored in source

claude_code.description: True if command_file exists on disk in .claude/commands/

codex.description: True if skill is in skill-registry (all skills default to true per AGENTS.md §A2)

ci.description: True if skill_id appears as preferred_skill_id in capability-routing-registry.yaml

parity_status.description: FULL_PARITY: command_file exists on disk AND in command-registry. MISSING_COMMAND: command_file absent. ORPHAN: .md file with no skill entry.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this entry was last compiled

command_file.description: Relative path to .claude/commands/*.md file for this skill

command_file_exists.description: True if command_file path exists on disk at inventory time

command_registry_entry.description: True if this skill_id appears in .claude/commands/command-registry.yaml

routing_routes.description: List of route_ids in capability-routing-registry.yaml where this skill is preferred_skill_id

product_track.description: Product track from skill-registry.yaml (e.g. foss_python, commercial_dotnet, layer_governance)

codex_excluded.description: If true, this skill is explicitly excluded from Codex discovery (default false)
